AVG.INTWO.label: Canadian Overnight Repo Rate Average (CORRA)
AVG.INTWO.description: A measure of the cost of overnight general collateral funding in Canadian dollars using Government of Canada treasury bills and bonds as collateral for repurchase transactions (repos).

BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 10-year
BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market interest rate for the 10-year Government of Canada bond and is used as a reference for financial market analysis and reporting.

BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 2-year
BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. This series reflects the prevailing interest rate for the 2-year term and is used to monitor short-term government borrowing costs.

BD.CDN.3YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 3-year
BD.CDN.3YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 3-year benchmark bond. This series measures the market interest rate for the Government of Canada’s 3-year bond, which serves as a reference rate for Canadian dollar-denominated debt securities.

BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 5-year
BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 5-year benchmark bond. This series reports the prevailing yield for the 5-year maturity point on the Canadian government bond yield curve.

BD.CDN.7YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield, 7-year
BD.CDN.7YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 7-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market yield for the 7-year maturity point on the Government of Canada yield curve.

BR.CDN.label: Bank Rate
BR.CDN.description: The Bank Rate, which is the upper limit of the Bank of Canada’s operating band for the overnight interest rate.

CORRA_NUMBER_OF_SUBMITTERS.label: CORRA: number of unique data submitters
CORRA_NUMBER_OF_SUBMITTERS.description: The number of unique data submitters used in the calculation of CORRA before trimming.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_25.label: CORRA: rate at 25th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_25.description: The rate at the 25th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_75.label: CORRA: rate at 75th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
CORRA_RATE_AT_PERCENTILE_75.description: The rate at the 75th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

CORRA_TOTAL_VOLUME.label: CORRA: total dollar trading volume of all trades eligible
CORRA_TOTAL_VOLUME.description: The total nominal value of CORRA transactions before trimming the bottom 25 percent.

OPERATING.BAND.LO.label: Operating band, low
OPERATING.BAND.LO.description: The lower limit of the Bank of Canada’s operating band for the overnight interest rate. (V39076)

TB.CDN.180D.MID.label: Treasury bills, 6-month
TB.CDN.180D.MID.description: The mid-market yield for Government of Canada treasury bills with a 6-month maturity. Treasury bill yields presented are an average of sample secondary market yields taken throughout the business day. (V39066)

TB.CDN.1Y.MID.label: Treasury bills, 1-year
TB.CDN.1Y.MID.description: The mid-market yield for Government of Canada treasury bills with a 1-year maturity. Treasury bill yields presented are an average of sample secondary market yields taken throughout the business day. (V39067)

TB.CDN.90D.MID.label: Treasury bills, 3-month
TB.CDN.90D.MID.description: The mid-market yield for Government of Canada treasury bills with a 3-month maturity. Treasury bill yields presented are an average of sample secondary market yields taken throughout the business day. (V39065)

V39079.label: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
V39079.description: Also called the policy interest rate, the average rate that the Bank of Canada wants to see in the market for overnight money market financing. (V39079)
